_comment: Activation and installation registry. Agent entries are consumed by lib/adaptive_engine.resolve_active_agents() and lib/agent_workspace.install_agents(): tier-gated agents activate at a minimum effective tier, conditional agents activate from detected capabilities, and on-demand agents are installed only by `ratchery agents enable <name>`. The 4 original baseline agents (explorer, reviewer, security-reviewer, test-runner) also remain hardcoded in agent_workspace.ALWAYS_ON_AGENTS for backward compatibility. The skills.available inventory is consumed by global_guidance(); every listed global Skill is installed and advertised to both clients, while its full instructions load only when the client's description matching selects it. There is no fictitious always-on/on-demand split for globally installed Skills. The 4 project-level conditional Skills remain capability-triggered in install_conditional_skills().

explorer.note: Active by convention from T0 onward; not literally required by tier_requirements().

reviewer.note: Active by convention from T0 onward; not literally required by tier_requirements().

developer.note: Active by convention from T0 onward; not literally required by tier_requirements().

test-runner.note: Recommended from T1 onward by convention; not a literal tier_requirements() entry.

debugger.note: Recommended from T1 onward by convention; not a literal tier_requirements() entry.

qa.note: Listed verbatim in tier_requirements()['T3']['required_agents'] (added on top of T2's set).

devops-engineer.note: Recommended from T2 onward by convention (CI required at T2); not a literal tier_requirements() entry.

documentation.note: Recommended from T1 onward, aligned with required_docs first appearing at T1; not a literal tier_requirements() entry.

embedded-engineer.note: No reliable static repo signal for embedded work exists in profile(); invoked explicitly rather than guessed.

performance-engineer.note: Performance work is task-driven, not repo-shape-driven; no static signal is reliable enough to auto-trigger this.

skills._comment: All global Skills are installed and discoverable. Clients inspect compact metadata and load a Skill's body only when its trigger matches; none of these bodies should be described as loaded every session. This list must exactly match the Skill directories on disk.
